title: Prepare For Sale
subtitle: Inspect the device, link it to the catalog and save its sale details. The same device record and IMEI become sellable in POS; the website shows it only when publish is on.

errors.load_failed: Could not load the device details.
errors.save_failed: Could not mark the device Ready For Sale.

device.title: Device
device.summary: The physical device from stock. These identity details are not changed here.

catalog.title: Catalog product
catalog.summary: Pick the catalog product this device is sold under. A matching product is reused; a new one is created only when nothing matches.
catalog.no_match: No matching catalog product. A new product will be created.
catalog.used_rule: Only used / pre-owned / refurbished products are listed, so a used phone never joins a new-phone listing.

variant.title: Variant & condition
variant.summary: The spec combination of this device. Devices with the same specs share one variant.
variant.create: No matching variant. A new variant is created under the product.
variant.match_rule: Same condition + colour + storage + RAM + region + SIM = same variant.

price.title: Price & sale rules
price.summary: The price is saved on this device. The purchase cost is never changed.
price.website_help: Off keeps it in POS only.
price.show_branch_help: No = the website only says the product is available, without branch name or piece count.

warranty.title: Warranty & box
warranty.summary: Warranty and box details shown to the customer.

content.title: Product page content
content.summary: The same sections as the New Product form. They are saved on the catalog product and shared by every device of it.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.summary: Anything found while checking the device.
inspection.placeholder: Screen, body, camera, speaker, Face ID, charging...

images.title: Images
images.help: Purchase photos are linked, not copied. Up to 5 images per device.

result.title: On save
result.variant_reuse: Adds the device to the matching variant
result.same_device: Keeps the same device record and IMEI
result.stock_same: Stock stays the same (already Ready For Sale)
result.cost_kept: Keeps the purchase cost for profit
result.website_off: POS only, hidden on the website
